evidence_class: Scoped fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fakeredis, fixture clock; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.quota.QuotaObservations.publish: grant-only; account, execution and generation come from the validated launch grant; reports outside the provider window schema raise invalid_request and write nothing; an older or replayed report returns the stored newer observation and counts as stale
QuotaObservations.reading and cap: unknown for absent, failed, partial or older than 900 s readings; cap 0 when unknown or without room
QuotaObservations.admit: admit, handoff to a configured account with at least 5 percent routing left, or one bounded 300 s wait per account and harness

scripts.swarm_v2.quota.latest_all and fleet_observations: the newest observation per account, aged ones with empty windows, drifted records skipped, empty unless AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_QUOTA=1 or when the store is unreachable

hooks.context.quota_policy._other_accounts(sessions, fleet): merges fleet observations with the local router cache, newest per account, the fleet wins a tie; evaluate passes fleet_observations(os.environ); decide is unchanged

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards passed in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: SV2-CTL launch grants (LaunchAuthority), Redis WATCH/MULTI on the quota keys under the swarm root
supported_versions.harnesses: claude and codex observations are stored separately; quota_policy reads the claude harness
supported_versions.compatibility: With AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_QUOTA unset, quota_policy reads only the local router cache, the preceding behaviour

states.observed: Provider window reports from a grant holder and the local router cache
states.accepted: A report whose grant validates for this swarm and whose fields match the provider window schema
states.committed: Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction on the quota, quota-history, quota-stale and quota-waits keys
states.externally_verified: None; no live launch publishes observations yet

recovery_contract.obligation: A provider outage leads to bounded wait or configured handoff without repeated unbounded agent starts
recovery_contract.result: An error report makes the reading unknown; admit returns one 300 s wait that repeated calls do not extend, hands off when the configured account has room, and the newer exhausted observation survives an owner restart and a stale replay

validation.red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38050367889 on the tests-only commit fafd35c3 failed: the quota module did not exist
validation.unit: All Python unit shards on 3.11 and 3.12 passed; 131 quota and quota policy test ids, 252 PASSED rows, none failed; case A ran twice on independent fixtures
validation.mutation: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38054941544 passed on 37077bcf: quota.py 403 killed, quota_policy.py 9 killed, no survivors
validation.review: Standards reader closed after two rounds, Spec reader after three
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on 37077bcf

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own fakeredis swarm built from quota-observations.json at fixture clock 270000 ms; account fixture, harness claude

rollback_rehearsal.action: Unset AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_QUOTA: fleet_observations returns nothing and quota_policy routes on the local router cache alone; QuotaObservations.admit stays conservative, never admitting on unknown data
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Recorded quota observations and history stay stored untouched while the switch is off and are read again when it is on; they are authoritative and never deleted as caches

remaining_limitations: admit and cap have no production caller yet; the distributed launch path that also calls AccountCapacity.reserve is a later package
No live launch publishes observations yet; the publisher wiring belongs to the worker and controller packages
quota_observation_age_seconds is collected as evidence only; no metric exporter emits it
quota_policy reads only the claude harness
The freshness limit of 900 s is the session band constant; a provider with slower reporting reads unknown
